notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp6-7; Total column p7). Business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, enterprise Total column (p11; Electric/Water on p10); internal service funds excluded (their combining statements pp26-27 not recorded in detail). Business-type reported totals are operating + nonoperating added (no single printed total; total expenses 15,073,687 also printed on Statement of Activities p2). ending_cash = Total Governmental Funds Cash and cash equivalents 2,802,134 (p5); restricted cash 7,207,287 and county treasurer cash 54,074 not included. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); internal balances net to zero in Total. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis) for General, Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service, Redevelopment and Airport funds (pp16-21); the General Fund budget schedule's 'Loan proceeds' and Redevelopment 'Bond/loan proceeds' are inside Total resources, recorded as other financing with printed_in revenue. Nonmajor combining statement has 15 fund columns (pp22-25), so its Total Nonmajor column is recorded as 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'. Debt Service Fund schedule prints no total line (only Interest income 733). TIF proceeds treated as property tax (increment), EEA tax as occupation tax (both flagged for review). No proprietary fund budget schedules in the trim. Read pages 1-27 of 27
